about: Touch swipe through CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent, one touchMove of 10 CSS px per virtual frame at 60 Hz (same step as swipe-v1), in strokes from y=880 up to y=100 (78 moves, about 780 px), then the finger lifts at once (no fling is produced: scrollY stops with the last move) and a new stroke starts after 2 frames, until the page end is reached; then a short tail. The browser's gesture detector and the compositor produce the scroll; no programmatic scroll and no mouse hover recompute.
